passage: Last Monday, I worked from home for the first time. My company started a new rule, and every worker stayed at home on Mondays. I woke up at seven and washed my face quickly. Then I opened my laptop and joined the morning meeting. My manager asked about my work plan, and I shared my screen with the team. After the meeting, I answered emails and finished two reports. At noon, I cooked noodles and ate at my desk. In the afternoon, my son knocked on the door and asked for help with his homework. I paused my work and helped him for twenty minutes. Then I returned to my desk and fixed a small bug in my code. At five, I closed my laptop and cleaned the desk. I liked working from home because I saved two hours of travel time. But I missed lunch with my colleagues.

sentences.text: My company started a new rule, and every worker stayed at home on Mondays.
In the afternoon, my son knocked on the door and asked for help with his homework.
I liked working from home because I saved two hours of travel time.
